title: P. G. Lejeune Dirichlet: Werke Band II Source-Checked Editions and English Translations
version: 2026-06-04 Dirichlet Werke Band II Papers I-XLI QA correction
description:
Dedicated P. G. Lejeune Dirichlet author record for source-checked editions and English translations. Current reader/source surface covers Werke Band II Papers I-XLI, including original-language cumulative readers, English translation readers, component TeX/PDF files, source scans, and checking artifacts. The latest addition applies a cumulative QA correction layer after the Papers XXXVII-XLI update: the public cumulative readers now flag Band II XXV and XXVII as source-witnessed repair targets rather than silently presenting compact/facsimile material as final clean text. R23 also adds source witnesses and a repair queue for those weak spots plus Volume I Paper I source staging.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Current public surface promotes Werke Band II Papers I-XLI as the dedicated Dirichlet author lane, with the R23 QA layer making known weak spots explicit. The older classical shelf remains an umbrella/backstop.
